title: VOOL LMC S – load management for homes and small sites
description: Load management for up to four chargers. Reads the meter’s P1 port or current clamps and is set up over Bluetooth in the VOOL App. From January 2027.

sections.title: Load management for the house, sized for the house
sections.lead: The LMC S protects the main fuse and lets the car use whatever the home leaves free. For sites with up to four chargers. Available from January 2027.
sections.alt: Load management controller in an electrical cabinet

items.title: Full charging power when the house is quiet
items.text: The charger slows down when the stove and heating are on, and speeds up when they are off.

items.title: Works without internet
items.text: Load management runs locally between the LMC S and the chargers.

items.title: Quick to install
items.text: Connect to the meter’s P1 port, or use the current clamps included in the box. Chargers connect over CAN.

items.title: Mount
items.text: In the electrical cabinet, next to the main fuse or the meter.

items.title: Measure
items.text: Plug into the P1 port or clip the clamps on the incoming cables. The arrows point in the direction of energy flow.

items.title: Commission
items.text: Open the VOOL App and set it up over Bluetooth. No Wi-Fi hotspot needed.

sections.title: Need load management before January?
sections.lead: Order the LMC Pro. It does everything the LMC S does, and more.
